title: Planaria have chaotic genomes yet regenerate, resist cancer and do not age

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Planaria have chaotic genomes yet regenerate, resist cancer and do not age

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: Planaria, despite chaotic mixoploid genomes from ~400 million years of asexual reproduction and large numbers of plastic proliferative stem cells, are champions of regeneration, cancer resistant and apparently do not age, the opposite of what a 'genome drives function' paradigm would predict.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: The Multiscale Wisdom of the Body: Collective Intelligence as a Tractable Interface for Next-Generation Biomedicine

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Levin M 2025, The Multiscale Wisdom of the Body: Collective Intelligence as a Tractable Interface for Next-Generation Biomedicine › Introduction

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: Despite that, they are champions of regeneration, are cancer resistant, and apparently do not age. This is the polar opposite of the outcome that the current paradigm of “genome drives function” would predict for the animal with the messiest genome, full of undifferentiated cells in the adult stage.

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Levin M, “The Multiscale Wisdom of the Body: Collective Intelligence as a Tractable Interface for Next-Generation Biomedicine”, BioEssays : news and reviews in molecular, cellular and developmental biology (2025), doi:10.1002/bies.202400196; section “Introduction”. Scope: Asexual planarian flatworms (e.g. Schmidtea mediterranea asexual strain)

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2025-wisdom-01: partially-resolvable, resolvability 0.66

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Public sequence data and extensive regeneration evidence resolve major descriptive components. Cancer resistance, absence of ageing and the claimed contradiction of a genome-driven paradigm have weaker or nonstandardized coverage, limiting a full test.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Quantify planarian somatic ploidy and genomic heterogeneity, regeneration success, neoplasm incidence and age-related functional decline, and compare them with preregistered taxa and genome-instability predictions. The descriptive conjunction is supported if high instability coexists with exceptional repair and low senescence and cancer.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Cancer incidence in wild and laboratory planaria is poorly sampled.

The paradigm prediction is not quantitatively specified.

Apparently do not age is stronger than available lifespan evidence.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
data adequacy: 0.55
discriminating power: 0.55
data existence: 0.75
operationalizability: 0.85
analysis feasibility: 0.55

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Genome disorder and regenerative capacity are the parts of the claim that public sequence resources and the regeneration literature can actually address. Cancer resistance and absence of aging are not in a systematic open cohort, and published carcinogenesis and sexual-strain aging studies already show that the absolute wording needs a narrower reading. The generalization is checkable in pieces, not as a single analysis.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: From public assemblies, measure heterozygosity, repeats, and ploidy variation in asexual Schmidtea, and compile regeneration success, tumor incidence under defined challenges, and survival curves. High genomic disorder together with high regeneration, low tumor incidence, and no actuarial aging would support the generalization; a stable diploid genome, poor regeneration, or a clear aging curve in the asexual strain would refute the corresponding clause.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Lifespan and tumor-incidence numbers are not in the genome databases and are sparse for asexual strains.

Sexual Schmidtea aging data do not directly cover the asexual animals named in the claim.

Champions of regeneration is a comparative ranking without a single coded trait matrix.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
analysis feasibility: 0.55
data adequacy: 0.5
data existence: 0.65
discriminating power: 0.6
operationalizability: 0.75
